Bare '(' and ' (' and plain quotes are 0. So is most ordinary English, such as function words, punctuation and common nouns like ' house', ' car', ' store', ' dog', ' table', ' year' and ' today' (all below 0.25): an 8-15-token English sentence with no parenthesis+quote token, none of the listed words and no time-of-day or weekday word is predicted inactive (peak below 0.44).
